text: It works but not as well as i would have hoped. I believe this works well in smaller settings. My bedroom is fairly large & i think that is one is the issues I have. The scent is there but it isnt as strong as I would hope? If that makes sense. It never came with starter kit & I like when they do that but this isnt my first diffuser so have some oils. The appearance of the items is not one I have had before. It is nice. Depending on the oil you use it's more relaxing then anything else. Its not that simple to use. But I like the shut off feature and you're allow to decided how much of the mist you want to come out. I love the light & how you can decide if you want it on or not like a nightlight. I like that fact that you dont need a lot of oil for it to work nor water. This is a great gift for anyone who likes smell good or someone who has ocd.

name: Amazon Customer
title: Fancy diffuser that makes everyday life smell a lot better
text: Got  this Maison Croyez Waterless Essential Oil Diffuser  and it has turned out to be one of those items that immediately earned a permanent spot in my home. I was interested in it because I wanted something that would make my space smell nice without adding another high-maintenance gadget to the mix, and this has been exactly that. The biggest thing I love is that it does not need water, which means no dealing with spills, no weird damp residue, and no routine of constantly refilling it like I am caring for a very needy plant. I just attach the oil bottle, set it up, and that is pretty much it. It feels simple in the best possible way. The scent output is also much better than I expected. I have used diffusers before that either seemed to do almost nothing or hit the room so hard it felt like I had been trapped inside a candle store. This one lands in a much nicer middle ground, and the three intensity levels really help with that. I can keep it lighter when I just want a subtle clean smell in the background, or turn it up when I want the scent to spread more noticeably through the room. I have been using it in a fairly open space, and it does a good job reaching beyond just the corner where it is sitting. That was one of my biggest concerns, because I did not want something that only made one square foot of my house smell amazing while the rest of it still smelled like real life. I also appreciate the timer settings and auto mode more than I thought I would. I am the kind of person who will turn something on and then completely forget about it the second I walk away, so having those options makes this feel really convenient and practical. I can set it and move on with my day without having to circle back later and wonder whether I left it running. That alone makes it feel much easier to use regularly. The warm ambient light is another feature I ended up liking more than expected. It adds a cozy little glow in the evening and makes the whole thing feel a bit more relaxing, instead of just being another appliance sitting on a shelf looking judgmental. What makes this stand out most to me is that it feels both effective and easy to live with. It gives the room a more polished, calm atmosphere without creating extra work. It is one of those things that seems a little indulgent at first, but once you start using it, you realize how nice it is to walk into a room that smells fresh and inviting with basically no effort. At this point, this diffuser has me feeling like the kind of person who has everything under control, which is funny because half the time I am just trying to remember where I left my coffee.
